metadata.source_document: all_placements_26_batch.pdf + 26part2.pdf (Somaiya Vidyavihar Mail - Placement News - AY 2025-26)
extraction_notes: Source is a Gmail thread export (PDF) containing 'HEARTIEST CONGRATULATIONS' placement announcement emails from the KJSSE Training & Placement Office, spanning 27-Jul-2025 to 21-Jul-2026.
PLACEMENT COUNT values in each announcement are cumulative college-wide placement counters (not per-company hiring counts) and are stored separately in hiring.placement_count.
hiring.students_hired reflects only the number of candidates listed in that specific announcement's candidate table.
Where a table used a visually merged role cell spanning multiple candidate rows, the role was propagated to every row covered by that merge.

Two pairs of announcements (IDFC Bank, 25-Aug-2025 result; and JSW, 13-Nov-2025 result) were sent twice by the TPO office in quick succession as corrections (CTC and branch respectively). These were merged into a single placement record each, using the corrected/final values, with the correction documented in that record's 'notes' field.

One Barclays announcement (result date 14-Aug-2025, PLACEMENT COUNT - 036) appeared to have its candidate table split across a page break in the source PDF; only the 3 candidate rows visible before the 'PLACEMENT COUNT - 036' banner were captured. This is flagged in that record's 'notes' field for manual audit.

One KPMG announcement (12-Sep-2025) contained two different CTC bands (5.00 LPA and 6.00 LPA) for two different role groups within the same announcement; overall ctc_value_lpa was set to null in that case and the per-candidate roles indicate the grouping.

raw_announcement_text was not populated verbatim for each record (source is a scanned/exported HTML email chain rendered as images); page numbers and structured fields above should be used to cross-reference the original PDF pages for audit purposes.
Company type field reflects the 'Type of Company' value stated verbatim in each announcement (e.g. IT, BFSI, Consultancy, Core, Other, FMCG, E-commerce, Other - Advertising).

The sum of hiring.students_hired across the first 98 records (from all_placements_26_batch.pdf) equals 308, matching the final cumulative PLACEMENT COUNT - 308 in that document, cross-validating that extraction.

Records PL099 and PL100 (both HSBC) were sourced from a second, separately-uploaded PDF (26part2.pdf) containing 2 further announcement emails that continue the same placement thread after count 308. Page numbers for these two records (1 and 1-2) refer to pages within 26part2.pdf, not all_placements_26_batch.pdf; consult the correct source file when auditing PL099/PL100.

PL099 (HSBC, 23-Jul-2026) explicitly states PLACEMENT COUNT - 310. PL100 (HSBC, 03-Aug-2026) had its PLACEMENT COUNT banner cut off/not visible in the supplied page image, so its placement_count is null rather than guessed; based on the sequence it would plausibly be 311, but this was not confirmed in the source and is therefore not asserted.

placements.notes: Only candidates visible before 'PLACEMENT COUNT - 036' banner were captured; table may have been cut across page break in source PDF.

Company sent two announcement emails for this placement on the same day (25-Aug-2025 result date): first stated CTC 13.08 LPA, second (3 minutes later) corrected it to 13.80 LPA. Both had the same PLACEMENT COUNT (051) and same single candidate. Merged into one record using the corrected CTC value; original erroneous CTC text was '13.08 LPA'.

This announcement lists two different CTC bands: 05.00 LPA for GET - Digital Trust role (4 candidates) and 06.00 LPA for GET - GRCS role (1 candidate). Overall ctc_value_lpa set to null because a single numeric value cannot represent both bands; see candidate-level roles for grouping.
